questions.prompt: Shindo Renmei was a Japanese-Brazilian nationalist organization formed after World War II whose members refused to accept a certain historical outcome. What did Shindo Renmei members refuse to believe?
choices: That Brazil had declared war on Japan
That Japan had lost World War II
That Emperor Hirohito had renounced his divinity
That Japanese immigration to Brazil had ended
questions.explanation: Shindo Renmei members, known as 'Kachigumi' (victorists), refused to believe that Japan had surrendered and lost World War II, and they violently persecuted fellow Japanese-Brazilians who accepted the defeat (called 'Makegumi').

questions.prompt: This Wikipedia article lists notable helicopter prison escapes; according to the list, which French criminal is unique for having escaped from prison via helicopter on two separate occasions?
questions.explanation: Pascal Payet is noted in the article as the only person to have escaped prison via helicopter twice, first in 2001 and again in 2007, and he was later involved in helping other inmates escape the same way.
